plain_text:
The Palestinian health system is working to transform the hospital
sector to deliver people-centred care through strengthening its
secondary care and reaffirming its contribution towards achieving
universal health coverage.
semantic_text: The Palestinian health system is working to transform the hospital sector to deliver people-centred care through strengthening its secondary care and reaffirming its contribution towards achieving universal health coverage.

plain_text:
The hospital sector is struggling to meet the needs of all patients.
Achieving health for all requires an integrated and people-centred
approach to provision of care in hospitals.
semantic_text: The hospital sector is struggling to meet the needs of all patients. Achieving health for all requires an integrated and people-centred approach to provision of care in hospitals.

plain_text:
At least 53 hospitals in the West Bank with around 520,000 annual
patient admissions, in addition to 34 hospitals in Gaza with an estimated
210,000 patient admissions yearly, will benefit from improved services
once the new hospital sector policy is implemented.
semantic_text: At least 53 hospitals in the West Bank with around 520,000 annual patient admissions, in addition to 34 hospitals in Gaza with an estimated 210,000 patient admissions yearly, will benefit from improved services once the new hospital sector policy is implemented.

plain_text:
WHO supported the Ministry of Health to reform its hospital sector
and helped develop a profile for the occupied Palestinian territory.
The Ministry is also preparing to adopt the WHO strategic framework
for action on the hospital sector.
semantic_text: WHO supported the Ministry of Health to reform its hospital sector and helped develop a profile for the occupied Palestinian territory. The Ministry is also preparing to adopt the WHO strategic framework for action on the hospital sector.
